name: application-rich-text-toolbar
title: Rich Text Toolbar
description: WYSIWYG formatting bar with a heading select, toggled bold/italic/underline and list buttons, and a link action, driven by real aria-pressed state.
useWhen: Building a rich text editor and need a formatting control bar above the editable region.
Users need to toggle inline styles (bold, italic, underline) and block formats (lists) on selected text.
The editing surface benefits from a heading-level select alongside inline formatting controls.
avoidWhen: You need a generic page/section action bar with titles and buttons — use `toolbar` instead, which is not text-formatting specific.
The content is read-only or plain text — there is nothing to format, so the control bar adds noise without function.
You need a full document outline or multi-row ribbon — this is a single-row, focused formatting bar, not a ribbon UI.
responsiveBehavior: Buttons wrap onto a second row via flex-wrap on narrow containers rather than overflowing or scrolling horizontally.
accessibility: The button group carries role="toolbar" with an aria-label describing its purpose.
Each toggle button has an explicit aria-label (since the visible glyph, e.g. "B", is not a reliable accessible name) and aria-pressed reflecting its active state.
Vertical dividers between button groups use role="separator" with aria-orientation="vertical" rather than a purely decorative element.
The heading select has an associated (visually hidden) label rather than relying on option text alone.

variants.title: Rich Text Toolbar
variants.description: Formatting bar with heading select, bold/italic/underline toggles, list buttons, and a link action above sample editable text.
accessibility: Toggle buttons announce their pressed state via aria-pressed, not just a background color change.

variants.title: Rich Text Toolbar (Dark)
variants.description: Formatting bar adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Active-button and hover backgrounds are tuned to meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark surface.
